problem.title: Minimum Index Sum of Two Lists
problem.problemStatement: Given two lists of strings, find all common strings whose sum of indices in both lists is minimum.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Next N lines contain strings. • Next line contains integer M. • Next M lines contain strings.
problem.output: Print all strings having the minimum index sum in lexicographical order.
